headline: On the same 6 requests (Haiku 5.5, 2 repetitions), plain Claude (A) passed 12 of 12 and Claude + the one-line hint (B, Jev live) also 12 of 12, with no case worse; B used 9.2% more tokens (1.51M -> 1.65M) instead of the 72% of round 1, and the whole gap is two runs with a stray harness tool call (the other 10 pairs differ by -0.08% in total). The cases are still too easy to show value, so the verdict stays INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Top suggestion: measure on cases that plain Claude with the full listing gets wrong, with only Bash and the hand-back tool available to the pick agents.

0.name: Plain Claude + the plain skill listing (48 entries, full descriptions)

1.name: Claude + the one-line skills-router hint first, then the listing (route.mjs --json -> formatLine, Jev live, agreement low)
1.engineVersion: typesafe/jev via OpenRouter decisions API, advisory hint

evaluation.datasetVersion: the same 6 requests as round 1 (S071, S077, S060, S044, S094, S172, test split) and the same gold; catalog = scrubbed git archive of ada217d (48 entries)
evaluation.tokenScope: all tokens of each case agent's session (input + output + cache read + cache write), from its subagent transcript (subagent_usage.mjs); the router's Jev call runs inside the helper and is in _logs, not in the agent's tokens
deviations: Round-1 suggestion 1 applied (one-line hint, printed first in arm B). Suggestion 2 (gate the router call) not applied: the harness always calls the router, so it cannot be measured here. Suggestion 3 (new cases) not applied: this round keeps the same six cases. Suggestion 4 (three Major findings) stays open and is accepted for this run. Suggestion 5 (drop the tool) not applied.

The measured commit is ada217d. Its `via` label takes the provider name even when no engine call happened: for an empty shortlist (c6, both repetitions) the line says `via: jev` and no Jev call was made. Not fixed in the measured commit; listed as suggestion 3 in improvements.md.

summary.json `providerCalls` (12) counts route calls, not engine calls (two were empty-shortlist abstains with no engine call). `providerLatencyMs` (1265) does not equal the sum of the B logs (14,608 ms). Harness metric issues, not fixed in this run.

Two B runs (c1 r2, c6 r2) had one extra tool call: a stray `mcp__ccd_session__hand_off_to_session` call with placeholder arguments that the harness rejected; the agent then gave the correct pick. Each extra turn re-read about 69k cached tokens and accounts for the whole +9.2%. Count: 2 of 12 B runs, 0 of 12 A runs (not significant). Neither run re-read the listing or re-ran the helper.

The pick agents see this session skill list and the repo; arm A was checked mechanically (0 router calls in 12 runs) and both arms for the answer key (0 hits in 24 runs). The gold stays in cases.json, outside the work folders.
Unit tests: 73 of 75 pass at ada217d; the 2 failures are the scenario-file sha256 tests, which fail the same way on main (CRLF checkout of eval/scenarios.jsonl). Not caused by this change.
Agent review (opus, read-only, on the pre-fix diff): 1 Major and 4 Minor fixed before the commit; the rest are open or accepted, with resolutions in agent-review.json.

Models: case agents Haiku 5.5 with effort xhigh, both arms, 24 runs (forced by the user). Improvement reasoning (spec, review, step 7b) on Opus. The round-1 folder and its helper are untouched; the round-1 helper would not parse the new default output if re-run.
